newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 232 OF SEPTEMBER 13, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 232 OF SEPTEMBER 13, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1782/96 of 12 September 1996 fixing the export refunds on malt
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1781/96 of 12 September 1996 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1780/96 of 12 September 1996 amending the import duties in the cereals sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1779/96 of 12 September 1996 fixing the rates of the refunds applicable to certain milk products exported in the form of goods not covered by Annex II to the Treaty

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1778/96 of 12 September 1996 amending Regulation (EC) No 2993/94 fixing the aid for the supply of milk products to the Canary Islands under the arrangements provided for in Articles 2 to 4 of Council Regulation (EEC) No 1601/92

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1777/96 of 12 September 1996 amending Regulation (EEC) No 2219/92 laying down detailed rules for the application of the specific supply arrangements for Madeira relating to milk products regarding the amounts of aid
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1776/96 of 12 September 1996 fixing the export refunds on milk and milk products
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1775/96 of 12 September 1996 amending Regulation (EEC) No 689/92 fixing the procedure and conditions for the taking over of cereals by intervention agencies
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1774/96 of 12 September 1996 fixing the maximum moisture content of cereals offered for intervention in certain Member States during the 1996/97 marketing year
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1773/96 of 12 September 1996 amending Regulation (EEC) No 689/92 fixing the procedure and conditions for the taking-over of cereals by intervention agencies
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1772/96 of 12 September 1996 laying down detailed rules for implementation of the specific measures for the supply of seed potatoes to the French overseas departments
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1771/96 of 12 September 1996 laying down detailed rules for implementation of the specific measures for the supply of hops to the French overseas departments
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1770/96 of 12 September 1996 opening individual invitations to tender for the sale for export of vinous alcohol
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1769/96 of 11 September 1996 concerning the stopping of fishing for cod by vessels flying the flag of Sweden END OF DOCUMENT.
